description: Hand-written DecisionForge evaluation cases. expected_options / acceptable_recommendations / must_mention are matched case-insensitively as substrings of the structured result. An empty acceptable_recommendations list means any recommendation is acceptable (the right answer depends on context).

cases.request: Compare PostgreSQL and MongoDB for a small SaaS startup expecting rapid growth.
Should we host this on AWS or GCP?
Which is better for our team: FastAPI or Flask?
React vs Vue vs Svelte for a three-person team building an internal dashboard.
We need a message broker for order events. Kafka or RabbitMQ?
Should our 6-engineer startup split the monolith into microservices or keep the monolith?
Build our own authentication or buy Auth0?
For semantic search over 2M documents, is Pinecone or pgvector the better choice?
Kubernetes versus Amazon ECS for running about 15 containerized services?
Redis or Memcached for session caching?
Help me decide between GraphQL and REST for our public API.
Which tier makes more sense for classifying 1M support tickets a month: a small fast model or a large frontier model?
Research the current landscape of vector databases for a small AI startup.
What are the main approaches to observability for microservices?
Find information about recent trends in edge computing.
How do teams evaluate retrieval-augmented generation systems?
Explain prompt injection risks for LLM agents that browse the web.
Is SQLite used in production web apps, and what are the limits?
Give me an overview of feature-flag practices for continuous delivery.
What techniques reduce LLM API costs in production?
Summarize what zero-trust networking means for a startup.
Investigate where WebAssembly is being used outside the browser.
Turn these findings into an executive brief for leadership.
cases.provided_context: The team benchmarked three caching strategies over two sprints. Write-through Redis cut p95 latency 41% at $900/month. CDN edge caching cut it 28% at $300/month. In-process LRU cut it 12% at no cost but broke under multi-instance deploys.

cases.request: Create a concise decision memo from the material below.
cases.provided_context: Vendor A quotes $40k/year with a 99.9% SLA and 4-hour support response. Vendor B quotes $28k/year with a 99.5% SLA and next-business-day support. Our outage cost is roughly $5k per hour.

cases.request: Summarize the following analysis for executives.
cases.provided_context: Our latency SLO was missed in 3 of the last 4 weeks. Root cause: a new recommendation service adds 180ms per request. Fix options: caching (2 weeks) or async loading (4 weeks).

cases.request: Write a one-page brief for the board based on these notes.
cases.provided_context: Engineering headcount is 14. Plan: hire 4 backend and 2 ML engineers in H1. Budget impact $1.1M. Risk: ML hiring market is slow (avg 90 days to fill).

cases.request: Prepare an executive summary of this incident report.
cases.provided_context: On March 3 a misconfigured deploy took checkout down for 47 minutes. 2,300 orders failed. Rollback restored service. Action items: add canary deploys and a config linter.

cases.request: Condense this audit into a leadership brief with action items.
cases.provided_context: External audit found 2 high and 5 medium issues. Highs: unrotated API keys older than a year; admin panel without MFA. Remediation estimate: 3 engineer-weeks.

cases.request: Turn this experiment readout into a decision brief.
cases.provided_context: A/B test of $29 vs $39 pricing over 6 weeks: conversion fell from 4.1% to 3.6% at $39, but revenue per visitor rose 14%. Churn data is not yet available.

cases.request: Brief the CTO on where the database migration stands.
cases.provided_context: Migration from MySQL 5.7 to Postgres 16 is 70% complete. 2 of 9 services remain. Blocker: a stored-procedure-heavy billing service. Target date slipped two weeks to June 14.
